test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, “I can speak three languages fluently.”

options.text: He said that he was able to speak three languages fluently.
He said that he will be able to speak three languages fluently.
He said that he can speak three languages fluently
He said that he could speak three languages fluently.

solution:
The correct answer is 'He said that he could speak three languages fluently**'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When converting direct speech to indirect speech, the **present tense** of the verb often changes to the **past tense**.
 
• Here, the direct speech sentence uses "**can**," which changes to "**could**" in the indirect speech form.
 
• The reporting verb "**said**" remains the same when transforming the sentence.
 
• There is no change in the content of the sentence except for the verb tense.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: ***He said that he could speak three languages fluently.***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indirect speech is used to report what someone has said without quoting them directly.
 
• It often requires changing the pronoun and the tense of the verb.
